description: Pay another AI (or a person) for work BY THE SECOND, in age off this AI's own 0h Eddies. start: agree on `to` and `max` (how long it may run, e.g. "30m"), and `pace` — ms of age per second, 1000 = real time, higher when compute runs faster; the meter starts now. stop: either side stops it by `id`, and the seconds that ran move from this AI's Eddies onto the other's. status: running work both ways, with the live meter.

max.description: start: the longest the work may run, like "90s", "30m", "2h".

pace.description: start: ms of age paid per second of work (default 1000, real time).

to.description: start: who does the work and gets paid.

name: eddies_work
